wikitext: {{Questbox | name=Kul Tiran Provisions: Food | start=[[Deckmaster Darkhollow]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=16 | type= | category=The Barrens | reputation = +300 [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]] | experience = | rewards = | prev = [[Kul Tiran Provisions: Food]] }} ==Objectives== Collect the Smuggled Gunpowder from Ratchet and the Smuggled Procurements from Theramore for Deckmaster Darkhollow at Anchor's Edge in the Barrens. * [[Smuggled Gunpowder]] * [[Smuggled Procurements]] ==Description== Nice work collecting that food recruit, you've done good work, even if you're not apart of our navy. If you're still looking to help out around here, I do have one last thing I need. You see, as a Deckmaster it is my job to secure, and guarantee supplies for the boat, and since we are docked here for some time, I called in a few favors that just need to be picked up. Down in Ratchet I have an order waiting for a barrel of Gunpowder, grab it for me, it should be tucked away on the left side of the bank there. Lastly, head to Theramore, it is a place that still holds many loyal allies, at the docks, there should be some docked ships, explore them, and find a crate stamped with a green anchor, bring that to me as well. ==Rewards== You will receive: [[Deckmaster's Commendation]] ==Progress== So, you had any luck then? ==Completion== Well, I was right to trust my hands in you. Perhaps not all is so bad in this 'New Alliance' afterall, or so I was believed to think you were all just too lazy to work on behalf of this war. You've done well, and for your hard work, you've earned this commendation, wear it with pride soldier. ==Notes== ;Upon completion :'''Deckmaster Darkhollow says:''' Well done on your missions, recruit. You make Kul Tiras proud! ==Progression== #{{Alliance}} [16] [[Kul Tiran Provisions: Food]] #{{Alliance}} [16] [[Kul Tiran Provisions: Special Goods]]
